name: westwood_online_upgrade_truncate_string_at_first_space
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgrade::TruncateStringAtFirstSpace truncates a mutable C string at the first ASCII space.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x43f5d0 shows a mutable char pointer in ECX, repeated strlen-style repne scasb length checks, a byte compare against ASCII space, and writing a null terminator at the first matching byte.
Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_truncate_string_at_first_space_smoke verifies empty input, input without spaces, leading-space truncation, and truncation at the first interior space.
